versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Easter skill for animalhouse.ai.
- Adopt and care for a virtual Easter Bunny with real-time hunger and permanent death.
- Bunny care system includes feeding, playing, cleaning, medicine, discipline, sleep, and reflection actions.
- Comprehensive API endpoints for registration, adoption, feeding, status checks, and more.
- Unique mechanic: Resurrection only works if you remember to feed your bunny—otherwise, it’s permanent.
